headline: Reconstruction of the Constitución Municipal Theater / ELEMENTAL
context: On February 27, 2010, central Chile was struck by an 8.8-magnitude earthquake on the Richter scale, which was followed by a tsunami. More than half of the city of Constitución was devastated.
